source.quote: South Bow Corporation delivered normalized EBITDA of $1,020 million in 2025, slightly above our expectations of $1,010 million, with a modest outperformance driven by our marketing segment.
South Bow Corporation delivered normalized EBITDA of $257 million in the first quarter of 2026, which was in line with market expectations and modestly higher than 2025.
As a result, we have increased our full year normalized EBITDA guidance to $1.04 billion within a range of 2% at the upper end and 1% at the lower end.
